network_enforcement: The checker performs no fetch. Its Lean subprocesses run through bubblewrap --unshare-net with a fixed locale, timezone, umask, and one Lean thread, using disposable outputs and the existing pinned warm dependency closure. This is deliberately nonrelease evidence, not a cold empty-cache reproduction.
scope_boundary: This recipe replays the exact predicate, conditional composition, specialized zero-process witness, and zero-measure countermodel, then validates only the negative release verdict. It cannot supply validation master acceptance, a proof of the arbitrary-P/arbitrary-X root, H0/R0 review, accepted trust and provenance closure, cold offline reproduction, independent attestations, a minimal verifier, or a deterministic release bundle.
